name: Link Centre

sources.title: LinkCentre - Create Your Free Account (signup step of the Add URL flow)
LinkCentre - Upgrade/Pricing entry point (redirects to sign-in)
LinkCentre - Submit Website (linked from signup flow)

requirements: A free LinkCentre account is required: the getting-started flow is Account -> Verify Email -> Submit Listing -> Explore Dashboard
Signup fields: first name, last name, email, optional username, password, business name (optional), country; Google sign-in offered
Every listing is checked by a human editor, not a bot (stated on the signup page; LinkCentre has run since 1996)
preparation: Account details: name, email, password, country (and optional username/business name)
Website URL, title, description, and category choice for the listing step after email verification
Email access - the Verify Email step gates listing submission
workflow: Complete the signup form and submit - the progress tracker shows 'Create Account -> Verify Email -> Submit Listing -> Explore Dashboard'
Verify the email address via the link sent to the inbox
Submit the website listing (URL, title, description, category) from the dashboard / addurl flow
Wait for human-editor review; manage the listing afterwards from 'My Account'
watchFor: Paid tiers (Plus, Pro, Premium) are promoted for 'featured placement' during signup and on /upgrade/ - the free tier already includes listing submission, so skip the upsell unless featured placement is wanted
Marketing-opt-in checkbox on signup ('Keep me updated with tips, features, and special offers') is optional - untick to avoid promo email
Review is human and editorial; no public SLA was stated for free listings
countsAsLive: The website listing appears on linkcentre.com in its category/profile page after editor approval
unknowns: Exact prices/benefits of Plus, Pro, Premium tiers (the pricing page required sign-in)
Whether free listings carry dofollow links
